worldcombat.skill.stockpile.summary: Store power into the body one mouthful at a time, hooping an amber shell: each use raises Defense and Sp. Def by 1, up to 3 layers, and it can be stacked back to back. A real hit cracks one layer and takes the matching stage with it, and once all layers break the payoff is gone; when the shell expires or is removed the remaining layers and stages are reclaimed. Broken layers can be set to mend or to shove.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.use.0: Stack a few layers before a fight and cap both defenses
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.use.1: Stow three layers, then engage and eat the first burst
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.use.2: Keep the layers as a breakable buffer and make the foe spend hits cracking it
Each layer raises Defense by %1$s stage and Special Defense by %2$s, up to 3 layers.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.break.mend: Break direction "mend": each cracked layer restores %1$s of max health, good for a long trade.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.break.burst: Break direction "shove": each cracked layer shoves the attacker %1$s blocks away from the user, good for opening space and cutting combos.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.growth.0: At level %1$s the store lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.growth.1: At level %1$s the store reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.preference.b: Mend: each cracked layer restores a little health, good for a long trade. Shove: each cracked layer pushes the attacker back, good for opening space and cutting combos. Neither changes the stage a layer gives.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.preference.a: Consider storing again when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of storing; larger gives up topping up more often up close.
How many layers to stack before pressing in; larger is greedier and engages later, smaller engages on a thinner shell.
Each time the user actually takes damage one layer cracks: the matching Defense and Sp. Def stage is lost with it and the chosen break direction fires; once all three layers crack the shell is gone and the payoff is lost.
